title: Isolation and Culture of Primary Mouse Astrocytes and Neurons
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Carefully remove enzyme solution from the tissue

steps.title: Wash and Prepare Glass Coverslips
steps.instruction: Clean glass coverslips (cs) and prepare them for coating in a 24-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Wash coverslips overnight in Nitric Acid on a wobbler, covered with parafilm.
Wash 3 times for 1 hour each in Baxter water.
Wash once in 70% Ethanol.
Store coverslips in 70% Ethanol (parafilm covered).
Place washed coverslips into a 24-well plate using tweezers and let dry.

steps.title: Apply PDL Coating to Coverslips
steps.instruction: Coat the prepared coverslips with Poly-D Lysine.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µl of Poly-D Lysine (0.1 mg/ml) per well/cs in the 24-well plate.
Press coverslips slightly to the bottom with a pipette to ensure they do not float.
Incubate overnight at 37°C.

steps.title: Remove PDL and Dry
steps.instruction: Clean the PDL-coated coverslips and store.

substeps.instruction: Remove the PDL coating.
Wash 3 times for 1 hour each with Baxter water.
Let the 24-well plate with coverslips dry.
Keep at 4°C.

steps.title: Apply Laminin Coating
steps.instruction: Coat the coverslips with Laminin before seeding neurons.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Laminin 1/1000 in Baxter water to a final concentration of 1 µg/ml.
Add 300 µl per well/cs in the 24-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C for at least 2 hours before seeding.
Remove Laminin.
Perform a quick wash once with plating medium.
Add 500 µl plating medium and place in the incubator.

steps.title: Coat T75 Flasks
steps.instruction: Prepare 75 cm2 flasks for astrocyte culture.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of 20 µg/ml Poly-D-lysine (PDL) per flask.
Incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Wash 3 times with distilled H2O.
Add AGM and allow to equilibrate in the incubator.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare buffers and media to maintain temperature and sterility.

substeps.instruction: Preheat plating medium at 37°C in a water bath for at least 20 min.
Prepare a box of ice.
Place HBSS buffer on ice.
Prepare several small petri dishes with 1.5 ml HBBS-HEPES on ice.
Prepare one 15 ml tube filled with HBSS-HEPES on ice.
Prepare Neurobasal medium by adding B27 and placing it in a flask inside the incubator to equilibrate temperature and CO2.

steps.title: Dissect Cortices from P1 Pups
steps.instruction: Isolate the cortex from postnatal day 1 (P1) mouse pups using ice-cold buffers.

substeps.instruction: Sacrifice P1 pups and wash heads with sterile PBS.
Cut off heads and transfer to a 10 cm petri dish with cold HBSS-HEPES.
Remove the skin and skull using fine curved tweezers, starting at the olfactory bulbus and peeling toward the hindbrain.
Remove the brain from the skull using a curved tweezer.
Transfer the brain to a small petri dish with 1.5 ml HBSS-HEPES on ice.
Under a binocular microscope, hold the hindbrain with tweezers and use sharp tweezers or small curved scissors to remove both hemispheres from the midbrain/brainstem.
Gently remove meninges, olfactory bulb, cerebellum, and brainstem using tweezers.
Isolate the cortex and place in ice-cold HBSS-HEPES.
Cut the cortex into smaller pieces in a small petri dish with HBSS-HEPES on ice and transfer to a 15 ml falcon tube with ice-cold HBSS-HEPES.

steps.title: Dissociate Cortical Tissue
steps.instruction: Create a single-cell suspension from the isolated cortical tissue.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove excess HBSS-HEPES from the falcon tube until 9 ml remains, avoiding tissue fragments.
Add 1 ml papain-based enzyme solution and 50 µl DNase (10 mg/ml).
Incubate at 37°C in a water bath for 20 min, mixing periodically.
Add 3 ml plating medium.

Dissociate tissue using a narrow flamed Pasteur pipette: gently suck up tissue and medium, then pipette up and down 5-10 times using a 1/2 flame narrowed pipette, then repeat with a 3/4 flame narrowed pipette (avoiding air bubbles).
Centrifuge the dissociated CX single cell solution at room temperature for 5 min at 1000 rpm.
Carefully remove the medium from the cell pellet.
Add 1 ml of plating medium to the pellet and slowly resuspend by pipetting up and down 3 times.
Add 10 ml of plating medium.

steps.title: Plate and Culture Neurons
steps.instruction: Seed the dissociated cells onto prepared coverslips and maintain the culture.

substeps.instruction: Place cells in the incubator (37°C, 5% CO2) for 2 hours.
Replace the medium with Neuronal Feeding Media.
Wash tissue 3x with 5 ml plating medium.
Plate 100,000 cells/well onto glass coverslips.
Swirl the plate gently to spread cells and incubate for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Isolate and Culture Astrocytes
steps.instruction: Prepare a single-cell suspension for astrocyte culture in T75 flasks.

substeps.instruction: Dissect cortices in ice-cold astrocyte growth media (AGM) and remove meninges with fine forceps.
Homogenize tissue by pipetting up and down 10-15 times using a flame-polished glass pipette (approx. half original diameter).
Add 9 ml of AGM.
Further homogenize by passing the tissue through a 23G needle 10-15 times.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant, add 1 ml AGM, and repeat the homogenization and centrifugation steps.
Plate at a density of three brains per PDL-coated T75 flask.
Treat cultures with 5-fluoro-2′-deoxyuridine (FUdR, 5 μM) 48 hours after plating.
Replace medium completely with fresh neuronal culture medium 48 hours after FUdR treatment.
